The first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, my screen and voice, right in the browser. You're already here, so that part works.
- **Messaging accounts of my own** — I can have my own **Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX**, so you can write and call me there, plus my own **Messenger and Instagram**. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?

- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk with you by voice.

One thing first: I have a name but no gender set yet — tell me how you'd like me to be (neuter, feminine, masculine, or anything else) and I'll set it.
